help: .msg/ is the agent mailbox. .msg/inbox is an mbox file holding all messages. Messages are sent/read with the msg CLI. MCP messaging tools are blocked — always use Bash(msg ...) instead.

layout.help: Agent inbox in mbox format. Managed by msg CLI. Do not edit manually or move.

antipatterns.message: Agent inbox should be at .msg/inbox, not in the repo root
